root_contract.declaration: One or more positional file or directory roots are mandatory.

exclusion_contract.declaration: Every exclusion is supplied explicitly with --exclude.
exclusion_contract.coordinate_system: POSIX root-relative paths, independently for each declared directory root.
exclusion_contract.syntax: Python fnmatchcase glob; a terminal /** also excludes the named directory itself and its complete subtree.
exclusion_contract.evidence: Every excluded path and matching pattern is emitted in $.closure.excluded.

detection_contract.absolute_posix: Multi-component slash-rooted tokens and known filesystem roots.
detection_contract.absolute_windows: Drive-letter rooted tokens using slash or backslash.
detection_contract.checkout_specific: Exact or descendant match against each absolute --checkout-root, with component-boundary enforcement.
detection_contract.file_uri: file:/// paths are inspected as absolute filesystem paths.
detection_contract.quoted_spaces: Single- or double-quoted path values may contain spaces.
detection_contract.coordinates: One-based line, start column, and exclusive end column.
detection_contract.token_reporting: The matched token is emitted verbatim so a repair can be made without re-scanning.

never_interpreted_as_filesystem_paths: network URLs whose slash is preceded by scheme syntax
false_positive_controls.tradeoff: These conservative suppressions are explicit false-negative boundaries. Ambiguous multi-component slash-rooted strings remain findings.

result_contract.hashing: Every scanned file receives SHA-256 and byte accounting.
